memorial_details:
Name: Wellington X HE 324 crash
Type: Stone of remembrance
Description: A vertical square tablet with the RAF badge in the top right corner and black lettering.
Inscription: TO COMMEMORATE THE SIX / BRAVE AIRMEN / WHO LOST THEIR LIVES / WHEN WELLINGTON X HE 324 / CRASHED IN THIS FIELD / BEHIND THIS STONE / ON SEPTEMBER 18TH 1943 // (6 names)
Location: Half mile east of Horwood church Roadside Horwood North Devon Devon EX39 4PE England
Grid Ref: SS 51190 27540
Coordinates: 51.027918688474,-4.123393368419
Photos: https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/105/332/large_74678_neil_webster_27_november_2020.jpg

The Wellington X HE 324 crash memorial is a stone of remembrance located half a mile east of Horwood church in North Devon, England.

The memorial was dedicated on the 18th of September 2013.

The memorial was dedicated in September 2013 after much research to identify and notify surviving relatives of the six victims.

Dedication Ceremony (18th September 2013): The memorial was dedicated during this ceremony.
